τρέφει: τρέφω — nourish, rear, feed; pres. 3 sg. act., of land or woodland that breeds creatures
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much, so greatly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’so many’ · also adverbial, correlative with ὅσσον: ’so far’
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’until’
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’) · also fem. gen. sg., of the person heard after ἔκλυεν: ’her’ · also fem. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (φιλότητος … τῆς ’that friendship’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέροι: φέρω — bring, carry, bear; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., of wish: ’may she carry’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to bring’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’might bring’ (ἵν’ … φέροι ’so that she might bring’) · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in an indefinite relative clause (ὅς τις … φέροι): ’whoever might carry’
φέρτατον: φέρτατος — best, bravest (superl. of φέρτερος); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φλογὶ: φλόξ — flame, blaze; fem. dat. sg., dat. of likeness: ’(like) flame’
φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φωτὶ: φώς — man, mortal; masc. dat. sg., after ἐοικώς: ’(like) a man’ · also masc. dat. sg., with μάχεσθαι: ’a man’ (ἀμείνονι φωτὶ μάχεσθαι ’to fight a better man’) · also masc. dat. sg., indirect object of κέλευε: ’to each man’ (φωτὶ ἑκάστῳ)
φόβοιο: φόβος — flight, panic; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), objective gen. after μήστωρε: ’of flight’ · also masc. gen. sg., after μνήσαντο: ’remembered flight’
χάζεο: χάζομαι — give way, draw back, withdraw; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic χάζου)
χάρμης: χάρμη — joy of battle, eagerness to fight; fem. gen. sg.
χαλκός: χαλκός — bronze; masc. nom. sg., also the bronze blade or spear-head
χείρεσσι: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic χερσί), instrumental: ’with the hands’ · also with ἐν, locative: ’in the hands’ · also fem. dat. pl., object of πεποιθότες: ’in their hands’ (χείρεσσι πεποιθότες ’trusting in their hands’)
χλωρὸν: χλωρός — green, pale green; of fear, ’pale, ashen’; adj., neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέος
χρυσῷ: χρυσός — gold; masc. dat. sg., of material: ’with gold’
χώρῳ: χῶρος — place, spot, space; masc. dat. sg.
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀθανάτη: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; fem. nom. sg. ἀθανάτη, a three-ending form (Attic uses ἀθάνατος for both genders)
ἀκωκή: ἀκωκή — point, edge; fem. nom. sg.
ἀλεγεινοὶ: ἀλεγεινός — painful, hard, troublesome; adj., masc. nom. pl., with the inf. of respect: ’hard (to tame)’
ἀλκὶ: ἀλκή — strength, prowess, defensive might; fem. dat. sg., dat. of what is trusted: ’in strength’
ἀλκῆς: ἀλκή — might, valour, prowess in battle; fem. gen. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμέλησε: ἀμελέω — neglect, take no care of (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act.: ’neglected’
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’answering’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc. gen. sg.
ἀνέρι: ἀνήρ — man, husband; masc. dat. sg., epic ἀνέρ- stem (= Attic ἀνδρί)
ἀνεγνάμφθη: ἀναγνάμπτω — bend back; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was bent back’
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — opposite, face to face; adv. or prep. + gen.: ’in opposition to, to the face of’
ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg. · also + dat., ’to meet, against’ (τῇ δ’ ἀντίος ’to meet her’) · also masc. nom. sg. used adverbially: ’head-on, face to face’
ἀντικρὺ: ἀντικρύ — straight through, right through; adv. (epic, = ἀντικρύς) · also of fighting, ’head-on, face to face’ (ἀντικρὺ μάχεσθαι ’to fight head-on’)
ἀπαινύμενον: ἀπαίνυμαι — take away from, strip; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., + gen. of the person: ’stripping (of)’
ἀπείρητος: ἀπείρητος — untried, without trial or experience; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’without making trial’
ἀπόπροθεν: ἀπόπροθεν — from afar, far off; adv.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀράβησε: ἀραβέω — clatter, rattle; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἠράβησε)
ἀρέσθαι: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain; aor. mid. inf. (2nd aor. ἀρόμην): ’to win’
ἀρήϊος: ἀρήϊος — of Ares, warlike; masc. nom. sg.
ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
ἀργύρῳ: ἄργυρος — silver; masc. dat. sg., of material: ’with silver’ · also masc. dat. sg., object of ἀντομένη: ’(meeting) silver’ (ἀργύρῳ ἀντομένη ’meeting silver’)
ἀρηΐφιλον: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, warlike; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀρχόν · also masc. acc. sg., epithet of Menelaus
ἀσπίδ: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. acc. sg., elided ἀσπίδ’
ἀτάλαντον: ἀτάλαντος — equal in weight, matching (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg.
ἀτρέος: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon and Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. dat. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλεῖ)
ἂμ: ἀνά (shortened and assimilated ἂμ before π) — up, along, over, among; prep. + acc.: ’along, across, over’ · also + dat., ’along, among’ · also ἂμ before φ, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂμ φόνον ’up through the slaughter’)
ἄγχι: ἄγχι — near, close; adv.: ’close by’ · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἄλλῳ: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. dat. sg.
ἄλοχόν: ἄλοχος — wife, spouse; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄντα: ἄντα — opposite, facing; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’opposite, over against’, following its noun
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, masc. acc. sg.: ’best’ · also neut. acc. sg.: ’the best (thing)’ (μέγ’ ἄριστον ’by far the best’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’the best (thing)’ (ὃ … ἄριστον … εἴη ’that would be the best’)
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἅλις: ἅλις — in crowds, in abundance, enough; adv.
ἐΐσην: ἐΐσος — equal, balanced; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀσπίδα: ’balanced, equal on all sides’
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐθέλουσιν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable: ’they wish’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλέγχιστον: ἐλεγχής — shameful, disgraceful; superl. ἐλέγχιστος, masc. acc. sg., predicate with σε: ’most shameful’
ἐλθέμεναι: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. inf. in -έμεναι (= Attic ἐλθεῖν): ’to come, to go’
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’) · also neut. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (τέκνον ἐμὸν ’my child’)
ἐμῆς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. gen. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐξαπίνης: ἐξαπίνης — suddenly; adv., epic (= Attic ἐξαίφνης)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπευξάμενος: ἐπεύχομαι — pray (to), make a vow; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg. · also ’vaunt, boast over’ (ἐπευξάμενος βαλέειν ’vaunting that he had struck’)
ἐπευχόμενος: ἐπεύχομαι — vaunt over, pray to; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’vaunting’
ἐπικούρων: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. gen. pl.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐρυσαίμεθα: ἐρύω — draw, drag; aor. opt. 1 pl. mid., potential with κεν: ’we could drag (for ourselves)’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’good, brave’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(it is) good’ (ἐσθλὸν … τέτυκται)
ἐσύλα: συλάω — strip off, take away; impf. 3 sg.: ’stripped off’
ἐτόλμα: τολμάω — dare, endure, hold out; impf. 3 sg.: ’dared, held out’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’ · also εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἔα (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’ · also ἐάω — allow; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= εἴα): ’allowed’
ἔαξε: ἄγνυμι — break, shatter; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented ἔαξε (ε + α): ’shattered’
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= ἔβη): ’went’
ἔγκατα: ἔγκατα — entrails, innards; neut. nom./acc. pl. (only plural)
ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’
ἔγωγ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε, elided (ἔγωγ’ = ἔγωγε): ’I for my part’
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg., in an indefinite relative clause: ’(whoever) might come’ · also after ὁππότε in past sequence, of an awaited event: ’should come’ (ποτιδέγμενοι ὁππότ’ ἄρ’ ἔλθοι ’waiting for when he should come’) · also after ἐπεὶ ἂν, potential: ’he would come’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause of hoped-for outcome: ’might come’ (καὶ ἂψ … ἔλθοι ’and might come back’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα μή: ’and he come’ (ὃ δὲ δεύτερος ἔλθοι ’and he come second’)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔναρα: ἔναρα — spoils stripped from a slain foe; neut. acc. pl., object of φέροι
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔπαυσε: παύω — stop, make cease (+ gen. of what is ended); aor. 3 sg. act.: ’stopped’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπεφνε: φένω (aor. ἔπεφνον) — slay; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist
ἔρεισε: ἐρείδω — press, lean, thrust; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἤρεισε): ’pressed’
ἔρρηξεν: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’broke’
ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
ἔσχε: ἔχω — have, hold, hold up; aor. 3 sg.: ’held’
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕ: οὗ, οἷ, ἕ — he, she, it (3rd-person pron.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’him’
ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address · also masc. acc. sg., epic elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορα), object of σχήσουσι: ’Hector’ (πελώριον Ἕκτορ’ ’huge Hector’) · also masc. dat. sg., elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορι), after ἅμα: ’with Hector’ (ἅμ’ Ἕκτορ’ ἴσαν ’went with Hector’)
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλωμαι: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with κεν: ’I shall take’
ἕνα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. acc. sg.: ’a single’ (ἕνα μῆνα ’a single month’); ’one’ (ἕνα καὶ δύο ’one and two’)
ἕνεκ: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., elided (ἕνεκ’ = ἕνεκα)
ἡγήτορι: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. dat. sg.
ἡφαίστοιο: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; by metonymy, fire; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’) · also ἤ = ἦ, interrogative particle opening a direct question: ’can it be that …?’ (ἤ ῥ’ ἔτι που σχήσουσι … ’can they still, I wonder, hold back …?’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or adverb of degree (ἤ περ ’than’) · also ἤ … ἦ, introducing a deliberative alternative: ’(shall I) … or …’ (ἤ μιν … θείω … ἦ … δαμάσσω)
ἤλυθ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἤλυθ’ = ἤλυθε), epic (= Attic ἦλθε)
ἤτ: ἤτε — whether … or (ἤτε … ἤτε); conj., epic ἤ + τε, elided (ἤτ’ = ἤτε)
ἤτε: ἤτε — whether … or (ἤτε … ἤτε); conj., epic ἤ + τε
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥβης: ἥβη — youth, young manhood, prime of life; fem. gen. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; fem. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (ἧς εἵνεκα ’for whose sake’) · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with its noun (ἧς ἀλόχοιο ’his own wife’) · also relative, fem. gen. sg., attracted into the case of its antecedent: ’which’ (τῆς … γενεῆς ἧς ’the breed which’) · also relative, fem. gen. sg., object of ἐέλδομαι: ’for whom (I long)’
ἰέναι: εἶμι — go; pres. inf.: ’to go’ · also pres. inf. as an imperative: ’go, return’ (ἐλάσας ἰέναι πάλιν ’having driven them off, go back’)
ἰόντες: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going, coming’
ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that he may see’ · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a general relative clause after ὅς κεν: ’whoever sees’
ἵστασ: ἵστημι — set up; mid. take a stand, stand; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., elided (ἵστασ’ = ἵστασο): ’take your stand’
ὀδοῦσι: ὀδούς — tooth; masc. dat. pl., instrumental: ’with teeth’
ὀλοόφρονος: ὀλοόφρων — baleful-minded (sense of the epithet debated); adj. of two endings, masc. gen. sg., agreeing with ὕδρου
ὀξέα: ὀξύς — sharp, keen, shrill; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’shrilly’ · also neut. acc. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’sharp’ (ὀξέα δοῦρα ’sharp spears’) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with δοῦρα: ’sharp’ (ὀξέα δοῦρα πεπήγει ’sharp spears were fixed’)
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
ὀρεσίτροφος: ὀρεσίτροφος — mountain-nurtured, mountain-bred; masc. nom. sg.
ὀχέεσθαι: ὀχέομαι — be carried, be borne along; pres. inf. mid./pass., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀχεῖσθαι): ’to be driven’
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὁμοῖαι: ὅμοιος — like, similar (+ dat.); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with αἳ (a dual subject)
ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄρνυτο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, rush; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ὤρνυτο): ’rose, rushed’
ὄρχαμε: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader (etymology uncertain); masc. voc. sg.: ’chief’
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπέμεινε: ὑπομένω — wait, hold one’s ground; aor. 3 sg.
ὑσμίνην: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
